instrument: Mendocino County 45-day urgency ordinance on data centers
summary: 45-day urgency moratorium adopted Sept 1, 2026, running to Oct 16. Deputy county counsel stated county code does not define data centers, so one could proceed on an ordinary building permit.
notes: Expires Oct 16, 2026 unless extended; on forward calendar.

next.event: Mendocino County hearing on extending the 45-day urgency moratorium (can extend up to two years)
